'''Kaemon Zahor''' was a male [[Human/Legends|Human]] loyal to [[Ukabi]] and the [[Exchange]] present on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] around [[3643 BBY]], when he was killed.

==Behind the scenes==
Kaemon Zahor appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on Nar Shaddaa. He is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.
